title: Carrot and Lentil Soup
description: A warming soup using carrots and store-cupboard ingredients.
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil||1 onion, chopped||4 carrots, chopped||100g red lentils||1 litre vegetable stock
method: Soften the onion in the oil.||Add the carrots, lentils and stock.||Bring to the boil, then simmer until tender.||Blend if desired and season to taste.
storage_advice: Cool quickly and refrigerate. Reheat until piping hot.
